node.statement: From W.K3>=W.L and epsilon>=0, W.L*epsilon<=W.K3*epsilon=t_3. From W.K3>=c0*W.L and epsilon>=0, c0*W.L*epsilon<=W.K3*epsilon=t_3. Combining the latter with node 1.2.3.1 gives c0*epsilon<=t_3. Therefore W.L*epsilon, c0*epsilon, and c0*W.L*epsilon are all at most t_3.
